selection_criteria.T2_headroom: Margin between current T2 and T2_grav_at_A_0; 3 = comfortably below, 1 = at the limit
selection_criteria.practical_accessibility: Can a partner group realistically access and operate this hardware? (0=exotic, 3=multiple academic and industry groups)
selection_criteria.mass_scale_match: Does platform's natural energy scale plausibly correspond to candidate's M_native scale? (1 = mapping open, 3 = natural fit)
